summary: The edit removes fingerprint contours but replaces them with repetitive crack or tributary networks, so the required mountain terrain is not legible.
required_changes: End candidate B at its five-attempt limit. Start candidate D with non-connecting broad ridge chains, no Y/T networks, and a corrected road protection path.
